### Lopsided Christians
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-march-2-2024.html
Passage: Ephesians 4:1
Points:
- Walking worthy of our calling means maintaining spiritual balance between belief and daily practice.
- Strong Bible knowledge is undermined when personal character and conduct remain undisciplined.
- Emotional zeal without sound doctrine leaves believers vulnerable to deception and false gospels.
- Faithful Christian growth requires sound biblical truth and holy living to coordinate together.

### A Softer Heart for Family Tension
Author: Rev. Kyle Norman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-nightly-prayer/a-softer-heart-for-family-tension.html
Passage: Ephesians 4:2
Points:
- Close relationships often produce the deepest personal hurts and misunderstandings.
- Bearing with others in love calls us to recognize shared human frailty and imperfection.
- True patience provides others with time and emotional space to process, heal, and apologize.
- Remembering how Jesus forgives and holds us enables believers to soften relational friction.

### Speaking the Truth in Love
Author: Guy Richard
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/speaking-truth-in-love
Passage: Ephesians 4:15
Points:
- Biblical love must govern both how and when believers speak truth to one another.
- Loving speech requires careful attention to tone, attitude, and avoiding unnecessary offense.
- Love sometimes exercises restraint by remaining silent when speaking would cause harm.
- When difficult correction is needed, it must stem from concern for others rather than selfish pride.

### Speaking Truth in Love
Author: Tony Reinke
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/speaking-truth-in-love
Passage: Ephesians 4:15
Points:
- Christ's ascension establishes His cosmic reign and releases spiritual gifts to mature His body.
- The local church displays Christ's authority to the world through submission to biblical truth.
- Every believer is called to an ongoing ministry of sharing truth with brothers and sisters.
- Healthy discipleship avoids both harsh self-righteousness and cowardly silence that compromises truth.
